_doc: NONASK-1103 E1: plain-language labels for the evidence trace (vera/evidence_trace.py). No numbers and no thresholds. A missing or invalid file means NO trace is built (fail closed, never raw codes). DB-table target is owner-gated DDL.

not_matching.text: did not match the question closely enough

not_cited.removed_by_check: the sentence that used it did not pass the citation check
not_cited.unused: not used by the answer; no reason recorded

epistemic.reported: reported by the source, not independently verified
